title: Newtype Pattern
concept: The Newtype pattern wraps a primitive type in a struct to create a distinct type — preventing accidental mixing of different semantic values.
why: Without newtypes, you can pass a UserId where a FileSize is expected. Both are Int. Newtypes make the compiler enforce semantic correctness.
tips: Use newtypes for ANY domain concept that has a unit or semantic meaning
Combine newtypes with invariants for types that are BOTH distinct AND validated
Newtypes are zero-cost — they don't exist at runtime, only in the type checker
Implement From, Display, and relevant interfaces for newtypes to make them feel native
common_mistakes: Creating newtypes for everything — only when the types are truly semantically different
Forgetting to implement basic interfaces (Display, Clone, Eq) for newtypes
Accidentally allowing implicit conversion between newtypes via From implementations
